## Activity

During May 2021, West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 323 captures. Activity proceeded as planned, with session lists maintained throughout the month apart from routine leave. The recorded activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the site.

## Image quality

Of the 323 captures, 17 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 5.3 per cent. The result should be monitored as part of routine site review, with attention to maintaining consistently suitable image quality for grading.

## Grading

Grading identified 75 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 day. This indicates that grading was completed within a short interval following image capture. Overall, the site recorded 323 captures, with 17 ungradable images and 75 referable results during May 2021.
